name: survivor
desc: At 18th level, you attain the pinnacle of resilience. You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws. In addition, when you roll a Death Save, you gain the benefit of rolling a 20 on an 18–20. Furthermore, at the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half of your hit points left. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 hit points.
